function elementType(...args: string[]): void;
function elementType(x: number, y: number) { console.log(x, y); }

function restElements(...args: number[]): void;
function restElements(...args: string[]) { console.log(args); }

function tupleElements(...args: [number, string]): void;
function tupleElements(x: number, y: number) { console.log(x, y); }

function implementationRest(x: number, ...rest: string[]): void;
function implementationRest(...args: number[]) { console.log(args); }

function tupleTail(...args: [number, ...string[]]): void;
function tupleTail(x: number, y: string, z: number) { console.log(x, y, z); }

function shortTuple(...args: [number]): void;
function shortTuple(x: number, y: number) { console.log(x, y); }

function literalElements(...args: number[]): void;
function literalElements(x: 1, y: 2) { console.log(x, y); }

function narrower(x: string | number): void;
function narrower(x: string) { console.log(x); }

elementType();
restElements(1);
tupleElements(1, "a");
implementationRest(1, "a");
tupleTail(1, "a");
shortTuple(1);
literalElements();
narrower("a");
